title: Knowledge Offloading: Decomposing LLMs into Sparse Backbones and Memory Modules
abstract: arXiv:2605.29075v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: LLMs encode both general capabilities and domain-specific knowledge in a single set of parameters. We ask whether this capacity can be reorganized: keeping broadly useful computation in a shared backbone, while moving specialized knowledge into external memory modules. We propose \emph{knowledge offloading} (KOFF), a framework for decomposing a pretrained LLM into a sparse shared backbone and domain-specific memories. Starting from a frozen base model, we either jointly or sequentially learn a structured pruning mask and lightweight recovery modules, implemented as LoRA adapters and learned key-value caches. translated_title: 知识卸载：将大语言模型分解为稀疏骨干网络与记忆模块
translated_abstract: 大语言模型在单一参数集中同时编码了通用能力和领域特定知识。我们探究这种容量是否可以被重新组织：将广泛有用的计算保留在共享骨干网络中，同时将专门知识迁移到外部记忆模块中。我们提出了知识卸载（KOFF）框架，用于将预训练大语言模型分解为稀疏共享骨干网络和领域特定记忆模块。从一个冻结的基座模型出发，我们通过联合或顺序的方式学习结构化剪枝掩码和轻量级恢复模块，这些模块以LoRA适配器和可学习的键值缓存形式实现。在从3B到14B的Llama和Qwen模型上，我们发现12%到20%的容量可以从共享骨干网络中移出，同时基本保持困惑度和MMLU性能（最高达到完整模型的90%）。我们展示了LoRA和可学习的KV记忆是互补的，分析表明被卸载的知识具有特定的领域属性。
tldr: 该论文提出知识卸载（KOFF）框架，通过结构化剪枝掩码与LoRA适配器、可学习KV缓存等轻量恢复模块，将预训练大语言模型分解为稀疏共享骨干网络和领域特定记忆模块，在保持约90%性能的同时可将12%-20%的容量从骨干网络中移出。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a knowledge offloading (KOFF) framework that decomposes pretrained LLMs into a sparse shared backbone and domain-specific memory modules via structured pruning masks and lightweight recovery modules (LoRA adapters and learned KV caches), enabling 12-20% of capacity to be offloaded while largely preserving performance (up to 90% of the full model).
